title: dForge Module Settings
description: Module-level settings definitions: a flat map of setting code → setting definition. Settings are folder-scoped at runtime (values inherit through the folder tree) and surface in the Module Settings UI.

propertyNames.description: A setting code cannot start with '$'; $constraints is the only reserved key.

$constraints.description: Checks across this module's settings, keyed by constraint name. The settings are the columns of one virtual row, so each is an entity check constraint: SQL over setting codes. settings.set and settings.setMany run every rule naming a written setting, at the folder written and at each folder below it that overrides a setting the rule names; install refuses defaults that fail one. NULL passes, as in a CHECK.

expression.description: Boolean over this module's settings in SQL CHECK syntax, e.g. "default_discount_pct <= max_discount_pct": comparisons, IS [NOT] NULL, [NOT] IN, [NOT] BETWEEN, regex matches (~ ~* !~ !~*) against a string literal, AND/OR/NOT, + - * /, literals and setting codes (bare or "quoted"). No functions, casts or [field] brackets; IS NULL rather than = null. The settings it names are found in it: writing any of them re-checks the rule.

message.description: Violation message. Localizable via translations/<locale>.json under settings.$constraints.<name>.message.

fieldTypeCd.description: Field type code (must match one in dforge.field_type). Common values: text, number, integer, decimal, boolean, checkbox, dropdown, multiSelect, date, dateTime, time, image, file, fileList, lookup, color, currency, percent, html, markdown, password, email, phone, url, textarea, json.

baseDatatypeCd.description: Underlying primitive datatype. Older settings declare this explicitly; newer settings (using `formula`) often omit it.

label.description: Display label (newer style). Prefer this over `description`/`desc` for new settings.

description.description: Display label (older style). Use `label` for new settings.

desc.description: Alternative label key used by some older modules. Prefer `label`.

defaultValue.description: Default value before the user sets one. Type matches `baseDatatypeCd`.

formula.description: Formula expression to evaluate the default (e.g. "'USD'"). Alternative to `defaultValue`.

required.description: If true, the setting must be set somewhere in the folder chain for installation to proceed.

params.description: Field-type-specific parameters. Examples: dropdown → { options: [...] }; number → { min, max }; lookup → { link: { entity, otherKey } }.

domain.description: Reference to a reusable column domain. A bare 'domain_cd' means this module's own domain, then a tenant-created one, and never another module's, even one with the same code. 'module_cd.domain_cd' names a domain of any installed module; declare that module as a dependency. The domain supplies fieldTypeCd, baseDatatypeCd and params; declaring any of those alongside 'domain' is rejected at install. The setting keeps its own label, defaultValue, formula and required flag.

oneOf.title: Domain-backed setting
oneOf.description: Setting whose control and option list come from a reusable column domain. Requires 'domain' and must NOT restate what the domain owns.

oneOf.title: Inline setting
oneOf.description: Setting that declares its own control and parameters. Requires 'fieldTypeCd'.
